taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs (0.5-)1-2.5 (to 3) dm, unarmed.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs, rarely woody at the base.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves deciduous.

traits.spines.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): unarmed.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems erect, from rhizomes.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems from rhizomes, so a colony.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves on the erect stems.

traits.sexual_system.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers unisexual; the genus account names it among Rubus with unisexual flowers, plants of one sex.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaves mid green, wrinkled.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves simple.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 3-7-lobed, lobe tips rounded.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): lobes from the cordate base, palmately.

traits.leaf_lobes.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 3-7-lobed.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 2.5-6 cm long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade (3-)5-8 (to 12) cm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade reniform or orbiculate, base cordate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins finely doubly serrate or dentate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences 1-flowered.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: open flowers 2 cm to 3 cm across.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white, obovate, (8-)10-15 (to 18) mm.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits globose, 1.2-1.5 cm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits golden yellow to orange or reddish; sRGB by eye for golden orange.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits globose.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rubus chamaemorus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering May to August.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: fruit ripe July and August.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a low colony of upright stems each with a few round, lobed, wrinkled leaves and one white flower, then one amber-orange berry.

allometry.note: 0.18 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
